root_cause: Steps 1 and 5 of scripts/pre-pr-check.sh are tree-wide/repo-wide gates, not task-scoped ones. Step 1 (pre-pr-check.sh:16-31) walks every *.lean under Cslib/Foundations/Logic/, Cslib/Logics/Modal/, Cslib/Logics/Temporal/ and Cslib/Logics/Bimodal/ and fails on ANY sorry found anywhere in those four trees; step 5 (pre-pr-check.sh:74-78) runs a bare `lake build --wfail --iofail` over the entire repository, where each `declaration uses \`sorry\`` warning is promoted to a build failure. Neither gate has any notion of PR scope, changed files, or task file_scope despite step 1's 'in PR scope' label. Consequently the completion-bar item 'pre-pr-check.sh passes end to end' is not a criterion task 530 can satisfy by doing its own work correctly -- it is a criterion that can only be met when the whole repository is simultaneously sorry-free. Worse, task 530's own recorded guardrails freeze Cslib/Logics/Bimodal/Metalogic/BXCanonical/Chronicle/ChronicleToCountermodel.lean as an explicit non_goal with a frozen sorry baseline, and that file sits inside task 530's own file_scope directory and is itself one of step 1's current failures. So task 530 cannot make step 1 pass even in principle without violating the recorded user scoping decision that defines the task. The bar is unsatisfiable by construction, not blocked by pending work.

solution_path: Do not attempt proof work and do not wait on other tasks. The correct action is a scoping correction to task 530's completion bar. Replace the plan's literal item 'pre-pr-check.sh passes end to end' with the task-scoped bar that the gate actually supports and that already passes today: (a) pre-pr-check.sh steps 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9 all green; (b) task 530's declared sorry_baselines unchanged; (c) zero new sorries, axioms, blanket suppressions or shake debt; (d) containment and barrel audits pass. Annotate the plan's Success Criteria with a one-line note that steps 1 and 5 are repo-wide gates outside any single scoped task's control, citing pre-pr-check.sh:24 and pre-pr-check.sh:75 as the durable anchors. Then close task 530 as completed. Separately -- and NOT as part of task 530 -- the repo-wide-gate-vs-scoped-task mismatch is worth its own follow-up task (e.g. teach step 1 a changed-files or baseline-ratchet mode like steps 8/9 already use), since every future scoped Lean task will hit this same wall.
